name: Portillo's (Buena Park, CA) Charbroiled Chicken Breast Sandwich on Brioche Bun
whyItWorks: Located right on Beach Blvd opposite Knott's Berry Farm! Tender marinated chicken breast charbroiled over an open flame, served on a toasted brioche bun with mayo. Unbreaded, lean, and very gentle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Charbroiled Chicken Sandwich plain or with mayo only (hold lettuce, tomato, and raw onions).
